options.name: Responsive web client
options.description: Browser-based user product and account workflows.
ux_implications: WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard/focus and reduced motion
options.rationale: Explicitly requested web version; stack remains undecided.

options.name: Desktop client
options.description: Installable desktop experience consuming shared product APIs.
security_implications: Code signing, update integrity, local secret protection
options.rationale: Explicit request; OS matrix and release model unresolved.

options.name: Mobile app
options.description: Mobile client for schedule/job status and lead workflows.
data_implications: Secure device token storage and notification tokens
qa_implications: Device matrix and store sandbox billing when applicable
options.rationale: User says app version; intended OS definition remains open.

options.name: Accounts, workspaces and roles
options.description: Secure sign-in with user/workspace and least-privilege roles.
technical_implications: Auth provider and tenant model selection
security_implications: Tenant isolation, MFA/admin controls, session lifecycle
options.rationale: Login and shared-user product are explicit; provider/roles remain design choices.

options.name: Subscription entitlements and quotas
options.description: Enforce plan feature access, job/lead/provider/AI budgets and lifecycle.
technical_implications: Billing adapters and authoritative entitlement ledger
security_implications: Signed webhooks, replay protection, no client-authoritative entitlement
options.rationale: Subscriptions are explicit; gateway, tiers, price and store billing unresolved.

options.name: Country, status and niche configuration
options.description: User-configurable market and business category criteria.
technical_implications: Geographic/taxonomy model and source capability mapping
options.rationale: Explicitly requested; only source-supported status fields may be offered.

options.name: User-local recurring lead schedules
options.description: Daily jobs at chosen user-local time with timezone/DST-aware durable execution.
options.rationale: Daily chosen-time jobs are explicit; scheduler service not selected.

options.name: Free source mode
options.description: User may select eligible free sources with disclosed coverage/limits.
options.rationale: Explicit; free does not mean unrestricted or guaranteed output.

options.name: Paid source mode
options.description: Admin-approved paid providers can be used only with visible estimated cost and budgets.
qa_implications: Cost cap, timeout, failure and webhook tests
options.rationale: Paid options explicit; vendors and platform-funded vs BYOK unresolved.

options.name: Custom source and field options
options.description: Extensible custom fields/filters and controlled provider adapter onboarding.
technical_implications: Versioned adapter contract; no user-supplied executable code in MVP
options.rationale: User requested custom options; exact scope needs system design.

options.name: Provider policy and capability catalog
options.description: Every provider records terms/use rights, fields, countries, storage/retention, attribution, rate and cost limits.
technical_implications: Policy metadata and fail-closed adapter activation
security_implications: No access-control evasion; emergency kill switch
options.rationale: Necessary to implement user-requested source choices safely.

options.name: Lead filtering, sorting and export
options.description: User-controlled filters/sorting and entitlement-aware export with provenance.
ux_implications: Saved views and clear empty/partial states
qa_implications: Filter correctness, injection and access tests
options.rationale: Filtering explicit; exact filter list refined from research.

options.name: Bounded AI search assistant
options.description: Assist search setup, filter interpretation and summaries with provenance and user confirmation.
ux_implications: Explain suggestions and confidence; confirm actions
data_implications: Minimal authorized context and retention controls
security_implications: Prompt-injection defenses, tenant scoping, no secret access
qa_implications: Task, privacy, hallucination and cost evaluations
options.rationale: AI help is explicit; autonomous paid actions are excluded.

options.name: Administrative control plane
options.description: Manage providers, users, entitlements, quotas, jobs, cost, incidents and audit.
data_implications: Admin audit and support access logs
security_implications: Least privilege, MFA/step-up for sensitive actions

options.name: Usage metering and hard cost guards
options.description: Estimate and meter source/AI usage; enforce per-job and per-tenant hard limits.
options.rationale: Paid provider option makes spend control essential.

options.name: Product marketing landing site
options.description: Public feature pages with useful visuals, explanations, motion and accessible performance.
qa_implications: Visual, responsive, SEO and accessibility checks
options.rationale: Explicit request; design follows validated MVP.

options.name: Lead lineage, freshness and dedupe
options.description: Track source, collected time, field-level provenance/freshness, confidence and dedupe identity.
ux_implications: Explain data origins and stale fields
security_implications: Avoid unnecessary PII and raw sensitive logs
options.rationale: Protects trust and aligns with incumbent R2 dedupe discipline.

options.name: Shared versioned client API
options.description: Stable API contracts shared by web, desktop and mobile clients.
security_implications: Per-client auth scopes and rate limits

options.name: Durable scheduled job orchestration
options.description: Persistent queue/scheduler with idempotency, retry, backoff, fairness and circuit breaker.
options.rationale: Recommended over ephemeral cron, pending system design.

update_notes: Added candidate SaaS direction options from user intake; selections indicate requested capabilities, not implementation or vendor approval.
